verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents a public REST API with concrete endpoints: contacts (e.g., POST /crm/v3/objects/contacts), custom objects, webhooks and account info. It also has a date-based versioning scheme, a maintained deprecation policy, and per-endpoint OpenAPI 3.0 specs. The probe 404s hit root-level paths (/llms.txt, /openapi.json), not the documented /docs/llms.txt or the per-page specs, so they do not contradict the docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented for driving the product end-to-end.
